fields.name: Hostile
fields.desc: Actively seeks to harm the character. Will not accept Requests.

fields.name: Unfriendly
fields.desc: Dislikes and distrusts the character. Will not accept Requests.

fields.name: Indifferent
fields.desc: Does not care one way or the other. Default attitude.

fields.name: Friendly
fields.desc: Likes the character. Will accept simple, safe Requests that do not cost too much.

fields.name: Helpful
fields.desc: Wishes to actively aid the character. Will accept reasonable Requests.
